Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.model

Klasse Room

java.lang.Object
ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.model.Room
public class Room extends Object
Represents a physical room in a building with metadata and current events.

A Room has identifying information (name, floor), capacity information (occupancy, seats), accessibility, current status, equipment, a list of scheduled/current events. Instances are mutable via setters for most fields and maintain their own list of events.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • Room

      public Room(String name, String floor, int occupancy, int seats, boolean accessible, RoomState status, RoomEquipment equipment, List<Event> currentEvents, String description, RoomType roomType)
      Constructs a new Room instance.
      Parameter:
      name - the room name (must not be null)
      floor - the floor identifier (must not be null)
      occupancy - the maximum occupancy (non-negative expected)
      seats - the number of seats (non-negative expected)
      accessible - whether the room is accessible for people with reduced mobility
      status - the current RoomState of the room (must not be null)
      equipment - the RoomEquipment available in the room (must not be null)
      currentEvents - a list with the events currently associated to the room (must not be null)
      description - description about the room (must not be null)
      roomType - the RoomType classification of the room (must not be null)
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any required parameter is null (name, floor, status, equipment, currentEvents, roomType)
